title: TEAM (Transforming Episode Accountability Model, 42 CFR 512 subpart E): performance year 2 prices, participants' episode estimates and a status for every hospital
description: ESTIMATED from public files, not CMS's own attribution (method: docs/METHODS-LOG.md, `team`). `fy` is 2027: performance year 2 is calendar 2027, priced with FY2027 MS-DRGs. Prices are CMS's preliminary PY2 target prices in standardized dollars, to the cent, by MS-DRG and census division (1-9; the territories are priced with division 9). A participant's episodes are Medicare fee-for-service inpatient discharges from the latest data year (`meta.mupYears`), so they are a floor; its `target` is the sum over categories of n x price, to the cent. `status` holds, for every hospital in the hospital master, [code, arg]: in [participation], in27 [start date], ended [end date], maryland, outside [master kind], in_area_kind [master kind], ihs, unlisted, area_unknown, or cjrx [[code, arg]] (on the CJR-X list; the inner pair is the reason the hospital is not in TEAM). The codes are `$defs/statusCode`.

measure.description: The hospital's public value (lower is better) and its percentile (0-100, ties take the higher; 42 CFR 512.547(b)(1)(i)(A)) among IPPS hospitals with a value; null when the hospital has no public value (the calculator then uses 50, § 512.547(b)(1)(i)(D)).

n.description: Episodes: the latest data year's Medicare inpatient discharges under the category's DRGs, retired DRGs moved to their FY2027 successors (an assumed even split makes some counts end in .5). A floor: cells under 11 discharges are hidden and outpatient cases are not public.

price.description: The episode-weighted mean of the division's DRG prices over those episodes; the category average when n is 0.

hidden.description: How many of the category's DRG cells the latest data year leaves out (each 0 to 10 discharges).

lowVolume.description: Both data years' episodes, scaled by 3/2 to stand for the 3-year baseline, under 31 (§ 512.550(c)(9)).

categoryAverage.description: One category's {division: price}, plus `derived: true` when CMS gave no average row for it.

fy.description: Performance year 2 is calendar 2027, priced with FY2027 MS-DRGs.

meta.description: Source dates: the participant list's and the CJR-X list's as-of dates, the price workbook's date, the two Medicare inpatient data years (prior, latest), the quality values' Provider Data Catalog release, and the methods version.

categoryAvg.description: {category: {division: price}}: CMS's category-average rows. A category CMS gives none for (spinal fusion) has the plain mean of its DRG prices in each division and `derived: true`.

participants.description: One per CCN on the TEAM list that the hospital master has, by CCN.

active.description: False when participation ended before performance year 2.

track2Flags.description: Track 2 eligibility the master shows (SCH, MDH, EACH, rural). Safety-net status is not public, so an empty list does not rule Track 2 out.

status.description: {CCN: [code, arg]} for every hospital in the hospital master (see the description above; codes: $defs/statusCode).

defaultCcn.description: The calculator's default hospital: the lower median, by target then CCN, of mandatory active participants with no Track 2 flag and episodes in 4 or more categories.

a4.description: `teamMissing`: CCNs on the TEAM list the hospital master lacks; `cjrxMissing`: how many CJR-X CCNs it lacks.
